title: Why Airplane Food Tastes So Bland #shorts
description:
At cruising altitude, the cabin air is very dry and the pressure is lower than on the ground. Reports say this can dull how sweet and salty foods taste by around 30%, and dry air also weakens your sense of smell, which is a big part of flavour. That's one reason airlines season in-flight meals more strongly.

Question: what's the worst airplane meal you've had? Tell me in the comments.

Made with AI assistance (research, voice and artwork). Events are simplified for storytelling.
